name: Should I repair or replace my old pool equipment?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my old pool equipment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace old pool equipment depends on the age of the unit, the cost of the repair, and its energy efficiency. If a piece of equipment is more than 8-10 years old and requires a costly repair, replacement often makes more financial sense. Newer equipment is significantly more energy-efficient and reliable, leading to long-term savings and fewer operational headaches. Consider the overall value and future operating costs when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evaluate repair cost against the equipment's age and energy efficiency. For units over 8-10 years old needing costly repairs, replacement with more efficient models is often better.
